triplets.subject: Kgcare
triplets.evidence_span:
4.1 Multi-Prompt Triple Extraction and Knowledge Graph
Construction

To enable precise and context-rich knowledge representation, KGCaRe employs a
multi-stage, prompt-driven approach for KG construction using LLMs.

triplets.subject: Kgcare
triplets.evidence_span:
By combining symbolic and neural retrieval, KGCaRe improves not only answer
accuracy but also explanation quality.

triplets.subject: Conditional Questions
triplets.evidence_span:
The objective of
these experiments is to examine how well KGCaRe performs in answering complex,
conditional questions compared to existing KG-based, prompt-based, and RAG-based
approaches.

triplets.subject: Cross All Answer Types And Llms
triplets.object: Strong Baselines Such As Vanilla Llm
triplets.evidence_span:
We evaluated KGCaRe on two complex conditional QA datasets, demonstrating
